title: Koo Tuh Nyoh

page_data.en:
Commandant.
S.V.C.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
（批：Please return this file to CENTRAL REGIST when finished with）

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 25
Date
January 25th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels here are expecting a big consignment of arms from Japan within the next few days.
The City gentry are raising funds to assist the destitute in Pootung and provide them with some comforts at Chinese New Year, and the former have petitioned General Yang to take steps to prevent the latter from crossing the river. Under the direction of the gentry whose name is Koo Tuh Nyoh 顾德钲 an office has been opened at No.160 Nanking Road near the Hong Miao 红庙 which will receive contributions to the fund for the relief of the sufferers from famine in the district of Nanwei.
It is rumoured that Chief of Police Zee Koh Liang 徐国梁 will be transferred to Peking soon.
The City Police have sent notices to the newspapers in Shanghai ordering them to change to the new monarchical calendar within three days. The sale of newspapers failing to comply with the order will be forbidden in Chinese territory. It is said that the Shenpao 申报 and the Sin Wan Pao have expressed their determination to ignore the notices.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：Entered on ms. Jan 25.）

警长。
上海义勇队。

（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探科））
（批：使用完毕后请将此卷宗归还中央登记处）

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处。
情报官登记室
第 25 号
日期
1916年1月25日

先生，
据报，此地的反叛者预计在未来几天内将从日本收到一大批武器。
本市士绅正在筹集资金，以援助浦东的贫民，并在农历新年期间为他们提供一些慰问品；前述士绅已请愿杨将军采取措施，阻止后者渡江。在名为顾德钲（Koo Tuh Nyoh）的士绅指导下，已在靠近红庙（Hong Miao）的南京路160号开设了一处办事处，用于接收捐款，以救济南汇地区遭受饥荒的灾民。
有谣言称，警察局长徐国梁（Zee Koh Liang）不久将被调往北京。
华界警方已向上海的报纸发出通知，命令其在三天内改用新的君主制历法。凡不遵守该命令的报纸，将在华界禁止销售。据说，《申报》和《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）已表示决心无视这些通知。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席探长。

警察总监上尉。

（左侧手写批注：于1月25日录入手稿。）
